description: Represents the results of a quality assessment that has been carried out on a data file resulting from an experiment or analysis. This is the natural home for repository QC metrics (e.g. BEDbase BedStats numbers). A typed QC vocabulary may later tighten assessment_method; for now it accepts a free string or a Term.

assessment_details_url.description: URL to a report containing the detailed output from the quality assessment.

assessment_method.description: Quality assessment method that has been carried out (e.g. BUSCO, OMArk, peak calling statistics, etc.)

assessment_values.description: Main values produced by the quality assessment.

title: QualityAssessment
